purpose: Deep source research for Baghdad (WUP 3303) after the 2026-09-29 pass and the 2026-10-04 Arabic-language pass ended with no verified open endpoint.
name: Baghdad
summary: No public parcel polygon source for Baghdad was found. Iraqi cadastral identity (muqata'a + plot number) exists only in the Real Estate Registration Directorate's records, whose electronic deed and property-map services are owner-directed requests through the Ur e-government portal in six Baghdad directorates, not a public map. No Iraqi government host exposes an ArcGIS, WMS/WFS or other GIS service. ArcGIS Online holds only neighbourhood (mahalla), district and point layers for Baghdad; every service that might hold parcels (an Esri-distributor org's 'Parcels' service, user geodatabases over the eastern governorate) answers 'Token Required'.

routesTried.source: Ministry of Justice, General Directorate of Real Estate Registration (دائرة التسجيل العقاري العامة), https://www.moj.gov.iq/
routesTried.finding: Announced six e-services via the Ur portal (https://ur.gov.iq/) including the electronic deed (السند الإلكتروني) and electronic property map (الخارطة الإلكترونية), in six Baghdad directorates (three Karkh, three Rusafa), after a Kadhimiya pilot; built with the National Data Center of the Council of Ministers secretariat. Announcement page https://www.moj.gov.iq/view.8589/ (page date 2024-10-21). Earlier automation of the Shaab and Karkh-1 registries with the Ministry of Industry.
routesTried.access: Owner or authorised-representative request per property; no public map viewer or geometry service is described. Ur portal service lists are a JavaScript app; nothing anonymous to query.
routesTried.verdict: dead end for an open layer

routesTried.source: UN-Habitat + Ministry of Justice MULK programme (Modernising Urban Land Knowledge), EU-funded, launched 2024-03-24 for three years, https://iraq.un.org/en/node/264204
routesTried.finding: Aims at a digitised e-land administration and e-cadastre (land-record digitisation system, technical specifications, STDM-based workflows, demonstration centres in Baghdad and Erbil per UNOPS vacancy notices).
routesTried.access: No published data, portal or pilot geometry found.
routesTried.verdict: lead to watch; nothing to query today

routesTried.finding: Site is a Nuxt single-page app backed by https://api.amanatbaghdad.gov.iq (404 at root from Germany, India, Iran, Turkey, US). The bundle's routes are about-us, bids, forms, museum, news, newspaper, radio, search, tenders, tree; no GIS, map or parcel route. www.amanatbaghdad.gov.iq fails everywhere (check-host: broken pipe from Germany, India, Iran, Turkey). The Mayoralty law gives its Designs Directorate (دائرة التصاميم) a GIS section and subdivision (إفراز) plans, and academic papers use Mayoralty base maps, but nothing is published.
Reachable (the 2026-09-29 pass saw only a challenge shell). Its 'خارطة بغداد' page (/a-map-of-baghdad/index.1.html) is an empty news category with no map content.

routesTried.source: Ministry of Construction, Housing and Municipalities and the Survey authority
routesTried.finding: www.mocmh.gov.iq and www.dgcs.gov.iq do not resolve in DNS from any check-host node (Germany, India, Iran, Turkey, US); moch.gov.iq answers with a browser-verification redirect. The General Authority for Survey (Ministry of Water Resources) has no identifiable web GIS. Literature says Iraqi cadastral sheets are paper maps on local datums.
Joomla news site; only external links are Ur, Tableau Public and a mail port. No geoportal or map service linked. Its HDX boundaries stop at sub-district (admin 3).

routesTried.source: ArcGIS Online search (https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/search) in English and Arabic: baghdad parcel(s)/cadastral/cadastre/plots/land/gis/municipal/zoning/landuse/blocks/mahalla, iraq parcels/cadastral, Karkh, Rusafa, Kadhimiya, Adhamiya, Mansour, Sadr City, قطع, قطعة ارض, رقم القطعة, رقم المقاطعة, مقاطعة, مقاطعات, قطع اراضي, القطع, عقار, عقارات, الاملاك, التسجيل العقاري, الكادستر, امانة بغداد, خارطة بغداد, الكرخ, الرصافة, الافراز
routesTried.finding: Zero parcel layers for Baghdad. Public Baghdad polygons are administrative or neighbourhood-level only: Baghdad_zones110 (https://services8.arcgis.com/BuDSiwZVG3gNaQUz/arcgis/rest/services/Baghdad_zones110/FeatureServer/0, 110 OSM-derived neighbourhoods/districts), a Rusafa land-use web map (item 4383f3f6b34a477dbaaf35930b80521b) whose feature collection holds 266 Rusafa mahallas with mahalla numbers and 8 municipalities, Esri Iraq distributor district maps. Property layers are points: 'املاك بغداد' (https://services-ap1.arcgis.com/9enuTV1GQKQEGy9V/arcgis/rest/services/املاك_بغداد/FeatureServer/0, 31 Ministry of Youth and Sports sites with a free-text 'رقم القطعة او المقاطعة' field) and the governorate's 2025 'أملاك محافظة بغداد' web maps (items 6ab4a6798ac6446d8cb8ca9fddc8ed11, ce6d50b3f6694199b1eff3dae8b2342c; small GeoJSON items). '201111_HLP_housing_plots' (4,724 polygons) lies in UTM 38N around 36.4°N (Sinjar, Nineveh), not Baghdad.

routesTried.source: Token-locked ArcGIS Online services that might hold parcels
routesTried.finding: The Esri Iraq distributor's org (https://services1.arcgis.com/lUwoyaNpSIRMtnlf/arcgis/rest/services) lists a 'Parcels' service plus 'الاضابير' (registry dossiers), 'مناطق_بغداد', 'Quarters_WFL1', 'baghdad121', 'بيانات_محافظة_بغداد' and small Baghdad items matched by 'عقارات' (Map_farah_WFL1, f); all return 499 Token Required. A user geodatabase over eastern Baghdad Governorate (new_file_geodatabase1_gdb, extent 44.59-44.94 E, 33.23-33.43 N, matched by 'رقم المقاطعة') and 'baghdad', 'baghdad_new', 'Building' services in another org are also token-only.
routesTried.verdict: not public; contents unknown; would need the owners to share them

routesTried.source: ArcGIS Hub OGC records search with a Baghdad bbox
routesTried.finding: The bbox filter does not narrow results (global-extent items dominate); Arabic keywords match unrelated items. No additional Baghdad datasets surfaced.
Searches for baghdad, iraq parcels, iraq cadastre, iraq land, iraq housing land property: boundaries (COD-AB to admin 3), HOT OSM exports, population grids, humanitarian surveys. No parcels.

routesTried.finding: Princeton ESOC '89 Neighborhoods in Baghdad' (https://esoc.princeton.edu/data/89-neighborhoods-baghdad) is neighbourhoods only. Stanford/Princeton/MIT LeadDog 2006-2010 Baghdad land-use and neighbourhood shapefiles are licence-restricted. Iraqi engineering papers digitise small test areas (Hay Al-Wahda mahalla 904/906 parcels with DGPS and aerial photos; 1930s agricultural sheets) and note that Iraqi registers do not give usable parcel geometry; no data released.
Land use and buildings only; no cadastral parcels. Not a parcel source.

reachability.method: Laptop curl plus check-host.net HTTP checks; check-host has no Iraqi node, so Iran (Tehran) and Turkey (Istanbul) stood in as nearest nodes alongside Germany, India and the US.

openQuestions: Whether MULK will publish any e-cadastre geometry (pilot areas, demonstration centre data) and under what terms.
Whether the Ministry of Justice electronic property map is a georeferenced per-parcel extract or a scanned sheet; it is owner-only either way.
What the token-locked 'Parcels' and 'الاضابير' services in the Esri Iraq distributor org contain (could be demo data); only the owner could share them.
Whether Amanat Baghdad's Designs Directorate GIS section would share subdivision (إفراز) layers on request; that would be a static import, not a live browser source.
nextStep: Keep Baghdad at no verified open endpoint. Recheck MULK/UN-Habitat Iraq and the Ministry of Justice registration pages in 2027, and the Esri Iraq distributor org's public service list for any 'Parcels' service that becomes anonymous.
